How do I log in to the portal?
With your employee number and your {n}-digit PIN. The first time, HR gives you a temporary PIN and the portal asks you to change it to your own.
I forgot my PIN, what do I do?
Ask HR to reset it. They will give you a temporary PIN and you will have to change it when you log in. Nobody else can see your PIN.
How do I request holidays or leave?
Go to “Request absences”, choose the type and dates and send it. You will be notified when HR approves or rejects it.
How do I report sick leave?
In “Request absences” choose “Sick leave” and upload a photo of the company copy of the medical certificate. Never upload the copy that shows the diagnosis.
Where can I see my payslips?
In “Payslips”. You can open and download them as PDF. You get a notification when there is a new one.
Open a ticket in “HR tickets”. They will reply there and you will be notified.
How do I turn on notifications on my phone?
In “My details”, “Notifications” section, tap “Turn on notifications on this device”. On iPhone, first add the portal to your home screen from Safari and open it from that icon.
Can I have the portal as an app?
Yes. On Android, Chrome offers “Install app”. On iPhone, in Safari tap Share and then “Add to Home Screen”.
How do I sign a document?
In “Documents to sign”, open it, read it, tick the box and enter your employee number and PIN. A signature cannot be changed once made.
